Full multioutput kernelridge on the symmetric single-effect vector SUM(A-control,B-control), including all1000gene features;100x100Gram. Hyperparameters selected on75fit/25calibration and frozen, then refit on100development. A coordinatewise ridge alone does not qualify this control.
